    Measuring guide

    Before you start

    1. Stand naturally. Don't breathe in or stand taller than usual.
    2. Keep the tape flat and level, snug but not pulling.
    3. Wear a fitted shirt and thin trousers. Empty your pockets.
    4. Take three photos now (front, side, back) in a fitted top, and attach them when you send your measurements. They let us check every number.
    5. Not sure? Book a fitting instead and we'll measure you.
    Book a Fitting

    Questions

    Good to know.

    How long does a suit take?

    About 4–6 weeks from the day we confirm your measurements. If you have a wedding or event date, tell us and we'll plan around it.

    What if I measure myself wrong?

    We check every set of numbers against your height, weight and photos before cutting. If something doesn't add up, we'll contact you first.

    What's half-canvas?

    A layer of canvas sewn into the chest and lapels. It shapes the jacket to you over time and gives the lapel a natural roll, unlike fused jackets that stay flat.

    What if it doesn't fit right?

    It's covered by the Fit Promise. Tell us within days of delivery and send a few photos. We'll pay for alterations with a tailor near you (up to ), or remake the piece free if alterations can't fix it. We then update your pattern so your next order is right first time.

    How do I pay?

    Nothing until we've checked your measurements with you. Then we email an invoice, payable by card or bank transfer, and start cutting once it's paid. You'll get an order number and updates as your suit is cut, sewn and shipped.

    Can I return it if I change my mind?

    Because every suit is cut for one person, we can't take change-of-mind returns. But if it doesn't fit or there's a fault, the Fit Promise and your rights under Australian Consumer Law cover you.

    How is it delivered?

    Free tracked delivery to any address in Australia, including regional areas. You'll get the tracking number when it ships.

    I have an event soon. Can you rush it?

    Often, yes. Tell us your date before you order and we'll say honestly whether we can make it in time.

    What if my weight changes?

    Suits have room in the seams to be let out or taken in by about 2–3 cm. For bigger changes, send new measurements and we'll update your pattern.

    What happens to my measurements and photos?

    We use them only to make your clothes. We don't share or sell them, and we'll delete them whenever you ask. See our privacy policy.

    Can I order again without measuring?

    Yes. Your pattern stays on file. Build a new suit and choose "Reorder with my saved pattern" on the measurements page.

    How do I look after my suit?

    Hang it on a wide hanger, brush it after wearing, and give it a day's rest between wears. Dry clean only when it's stained or smells, not after every wear.

    About

    A properly cut suit, made simple.

    Most men have never worn a suit made for them. Montier exists to change that.

    Off-the-rack suits are cut for an average body that nobody actually has. The jacket fits the chest but swims at the waist, or the sleeves are right and the shoulders aren't. Made-to-measure fixes all of it, but it has usually meant high prices and weeks of appointments.

    We work directly with an experienced master tailor. You choose the cloth and details, we take your measurements, and your suit is cut from a pattern drafted only for you. No middlemen, no showroom markup.

    The result is a half-canvassed suit, sewn by hand, at a price that makes sense.

    Fit comes first.We check every measurement before a single cut is made.

    Customer policies

    The fine print, in plain English.

    What you can expect from us, and what we need from you.

    The Fit Promise

      Returns and refunds

      Every Montier garment is cut from a pattern made for one person, so we can't accept change-of-mind returns once cutting has started. Before then, you can cancel for a full refund.

      If your order arrives faulty, not as described, or doesn't fit, it's covered by the Fit Promise above. Nothing in this policy limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

      Ordering, payment and delivery

      • You pay nothing until we've checked your measurements with you.
      • We then email an invoice, payable by card or bank transfer. Cutting starts once it's paid.
      • Your suit arrives in about 4–6 weeks from confirmed measurements. Tell us your event date and we'll plan around it.
      • Delivery is free and tracked to any address in Australia.

      Privacy

      We collect your name, contact details, measurements and any photos you send, and use them only to make, deliver and support your order. We keep your pattern on file so you can reorder. We don't sell or share your details with anyone except the tailor making your suit and the courier delivering it.

      Ask us at any time to see, correct or delete what we hold about you.

      Terms

      Prices are in Australian dollars and include GST. Cloth colours on screen are a guide; order free swatches if colour matters. Hand-made garments can vary slightly from the illustrations.
